# Carcavelos Daily Brief – Friday 21 August

**Light and clean this morning, getting choppy by afternoon.**

**Morning (4:00–11:00)**: Small but quality waves, 1.4m with a proper 6–6.75s period out of the NW. Wind stays light and offshore until 9:00, making this your golden window. Head out between sunrise (4:02) and 10:00 for the cleanest faces. Water temp 18–20°C.

**Progression**: Swell holds steady through midday but wind picks up noticeably from 13:00 onward, shifting N and hitting 23km/h. Waves bump to 1.5m but lose shape—chop takes over.

**Afternoon (12:00–18:00)**: Smaller period, stronger wind. Mushy and choppy by 14:00 onwards. Only worth it if you can't get out early.

**Tips**: Go early or don't go—seriously. Use a shorter board for the morning wind ramps. Skip the 12:00–16:00 window entirely unless you love hassle.
